- Valves that are not performing well and that have obvious mechanical defects (such as stem corrosion) should be removed and reconditioned.
- Use the valve manufacturer alliance with Fisher-Rosemont to ensure valve quality.
- Stem finishes of 4 rms provide the best performance.
- Avoid lifting valves by their actuators; instead cradle valves with a non-metallic slings.
- Use live-loaded combination packings for VDC control in service where the temperature is less than 450°F.
- Use graphite packings and oversized actuators for VDC control for valve in service where the temperature is greater than 450°F.
